notes: Brutal wind and endless switchbacks across a granite landscape that made every step feel earned
Ancient temples at dawn before the crowds arrived felt like stepping inside a woodblock print
Sat on a blue-domed rooftop with a glass of Assyrtiko watching the caldera turn amber at sunset
Crossed glacier tongues on crampons under skies that shifted from clear blue to blizzard in minutes
Lanterns swaying over a narrow canal at night and the smell of bánh mì drifting from every corner
Hiked between pastel villages perched on cliffs above a turquoise sea with no phone signal for three hours
Lost inside the medina souk while traders called out from behind spice mountains of saffron and cumin
Kayaked between sea stacks at midnight under a sky that never went fully dark in June
Rode tram 28 uphill to a miradouro and watched the terracotta rooftops glow in the late afternoon light
Cycled past thousands of ancient brick stupas rising from a dry plain at sunrise with hot air balloons overhead
Hiked to Sørvágsvatn lake where the water appears to hang above the ocean in an impossible optical illusion
Watched Día de los Muertos processions fill the streets with marigolds candles and masked dancers until midnight
Spent three days in an overwater bungalow where the fish swam visible through the glass floor beneath my feet
Trekked the Annapurna circuit for twelve days watching the peaks slowly reveal themselves through dawn cloud
Stumbled onto the Palio rehearsal and watched jockeys race bareback around a medieval shell-shaped piazza
Drove the ring road for ten days stopping at black sand beaches steaming geysers and midnight waterfalls
Classic American cars and salsa drifting from open doorways in a city that felt like a living museum
Snorkelled over coral gardens with manta rays gliding beneath me through water the colour of a swimming pool
Wandered through the White Temple at dusk while mirror tiles caught the last light from every angle
Wild-camped beside a loch under weather that changed four times in an hour and felt completely at peace
